developer_tickets.task: Decommission Google Translate Widget & Implement Static /ko Subpath Routing
developer_tickets.action: Remove #google_translate_element and the JS button. Enable Next.js i18n routing or build physical pages under pages/ko/* so search crawlers receive server-rendered Korean HTML.

developer_tickets.task: Dynamic HTML Lang Attribute in Document
developer_tickets.action: Ensure <Html lang={locale}> renders 'en' for English and 'ko' for Korean, plus <meta http-equiv="content-language" content="ko-kr"> on Korean pages.

developer_tickets.task: Inject Canonical & Bidirectional Hreflang Tags (Fixes 72 Duplicate Content Errors)
developer_tickets.action: Add self-referencing <link rel="canonical"> on every page and declare bilateral hreflang tags (en, ko, x-default). Eliminates 72 duplicate content errors in Semrush.

developer_tickets.task: Fix Critical Typos Across Service & About Pages
developer_tickets.action: Replace 'Busines' with 'Business' on services card 1; replace 'PT Inpartrner' with 'PT Inpartner' on about; replace 'East Jave' with 'East Java'.
Replace 'give you a home run' with professional corporate advisory language ('deliver measurable, high-impact business outcomes').

developer_tickets.action:

Contact Inpartner Consulting Jakarta & Surabaya

as the primary heading before the form.

developer_tickets.task: Separate Duplicate Meta Descriptions (Fixes 56 Duplicate Meta Errors)
developer_tickets.action: Replace the identical generic project management definition on /project and /blog with distinct, conversion-focused meta descriptions. Eliminates 56 duplicate meta description errors in Semrush.

developer_tickets.task: Whitelist Verified Search Engine Bots on Cloudflare/WAF
developer_tickets.action: Allow Googlebot, Bingbot, and Naver Yeti (Yeti/1.1) to access /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml without JS challenge pages.

developer_tickets.task: Disentangle /services Hash Anchors into Dedicated URLs
developer_tickets.action: Create standalone URLs for each service so search engines can index and rank them independently.
Change <h5> tags used for section titles to <h2> and sub-services to <h3> while retaining Emotion CSS classes.

developer_tickets.task: Deploy Unique Page Titles (Fixes 72 Duplicate Title Errors)
developer_tickets.action: Deploy unique page titles across all pages as specified in metadata_dictionary. Eliminates 72 duplicate title errors in Semrush.

developer_tickets.task: Translate Portfolio Project Titles on English Site
developer_tickets.action: Translate raw Indonesian project titles (BUJT, BRT, Getaci) into professional English and Korean.
Embed structured data in page head for both English and Korean pages.

developer_tickets.task: Resolve 'Meet our Team' Navigation Loop on /about
developer_tickets.action: Fix button looping back to /about; display actual leadership and senior partner credentials.
Resolve conflict between homepage (2009) and about hero (2019) by standardizing to 2009.
Inject og:title, og:description, og:image, and twitter:card tags for LinkedIn and WhatsApp previews.

developer_tickets.task: Inject Dynamic Excerpt Meta Descriptions (Fixes 16 Missing Meta Warnings)
developer_tickets.action: Pass the first 150 characters of blog posts as meta description. Eliminates 16 missing meta description warnings in Semrush.
Identify the 3 broken internal links flagged by Semrush (3.8%) and implement 301 permanent redirects in next.config.js.

mainEntity.name: What consulting services does Inpartner provide in Indonesia?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inpartner provides strategic business and management consulting, investment advisory, market entry feasibility studies, corporate valuation, ESG frameworks, and executive capacity building across Indonesia.

mainEntity.name: Where are Inpartner's corporate offices located?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inpartner operates offices in South Jakarta (Pakuwon Tower, 10th Floor, Casablanca) and Surabaya (Jemur Sari V No. 10, East Java).

mainEntity.name: Does Inpartner handle public infrastructure and feasibility studies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Inpartner has delivered major feasibility reviews, financial projections, and real sector evaluations for toll road authorities (BUJT), regional rapid transit (BRT), and renewable energy ventures.
